items.title: Unit 5 · Lesson 1 story
items.storyText:
What have we got on Monday? We've got English. Then we've got maths.

When have we got PE? We've got PE on Thursday.

On Thursday. Don't forget these. Oh yes. Our PE bags.

It's time for football. Put on your PE clothes now.

Oh no! This is Rosy's bag. I can't wear these clothes. I can't play football now!

You can wear their clothes, Tim. Thank you very much!
